source_refs.note: Sub-heading 'Causes of Network Delay' of 1.12 as printed (PDF 19, printed 14).

blocks.text: Network delay happens due to many reasons. Too many users can slow the network. Poor-quality cables can cause delay. Long distance between devices increases delay. Network congestion affects data speed. Hardware problems also cause network delay.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Identify possible causes of delay in a given scenario.
